by: charities-3 session, step 4.1: the Opus build kept and moved into the lane (proposed; the integrator appends it at the merge)
title: One page of the Charities Register's open data feed (OData v2, JSON), as the capture asked it
signals_note: GET http://www.odata.charities.govt.nz/<set>?$format=json&$orderby=<key>&$top=1000 through the fetch gate (registers/charities/capture.py); landed verbatim by hash.
notes: Organisations' MainSectorId, MainActivityId and MainBeneficiaryId are numbered as the vOrganisations view decodes them, not as the MainSector, MainActivity and MainBeneficiary code lists number their entries (same names, other ids). Dates are midnight UTC for a day. A register number may carry a -N suffix and is another charity. ModifiedOn is written and compared in UTC: a $filter literal is UTC. Officers' name fields can hold a typed birth date or an address (15 and 4 on the copy of 20 October 2026); the feed has no field for either.
applies_to: the Charities Register's feed, from 20 October 2026
process: Read a set's pages newest first; a row read again on a later page keeps the later reading.

Withhold an officer's name field that holds a date or reads as an address (a box or bag, or a street number of one to four digits not followed by a legal ending); note which field and why in name_note, never the value; rebuild the full name from the parts left; keep the row, and set it aside only when no publishable name is left.

Hold a charity's address for service (its street address) in the private twin; publish it only for a body corporate (Incorporated Society, Company, Charitable Trusts incorporated under the Charitable Trusts Act).
gates: Every row of every page is a typed row or a catch-log line (check.py).
The register's own vOrganisations names equal ours for every charity captured in the same state; no officer name column holds a date or an address (check.py).
